# Athoo — Pakistan's Home Services Marketplace

> Athoo is Pakistan's upcoming trusted home services platform. It connects homeowners in Rawalpindi and Islamabad with verified, professional service providers.

## What is Athoo?

Athoo is a pre-launch marketplace that will connect customers with background-checked, vetted local service professionals. The platform covers 10+ service categories and is built for the Pakistani market.

## Services Offered

- Electrician — wiring, fixtures, circuit repair
- Plumber — leaks, pipes, bathroom fittings
- AC Service — installation, maintenance, repair
- Carpenter — furniture, doors, custom woodwork
- Painter — interior and exterior painting
- Home Cleaning — deep clean, regular cleaning
- Appliance Repair — fridge, washer, microwave
- Home Maintenance — general handyman services
- Mason — small construction and tile work

## Launch Details

- Launch Market: Rawalpindi and Islamabad, Pakistan
- Status: Pre-launch (waitlist open)
- Website: https://www.athoo.pk
- Waitlist: https://www.athoo.pk/#waitlist
